name: ai-codebase-documentation
description: Create, audit, update, and maintain software-repository documentation against code evidence.

defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's documentation against the current code and report evidenced drift, gaps, and contradictions.
Update the documentation affected by these code changes, preserving existing conventions and grounding every material claim in implementation evidence.
Create or improve repository documentation for this codebase, using the code as the source of truth and validating the result at the appropriate level.
interface.longDescription: Create, audit, update, and maintain repository documentation against implementation evidence, including READMEs, developer guides, architecture, ADRs, API and configuration references, runbooks, troubleshooting, comments, examples, diagrams, drift analysis, and documentation change impact.
